entities.summary: Lakshmi Parvathi is an Indian politician from the state of Andhra Pradesh and widow of N. T. Rama Rao. She was previously married to a harikatha artist Veeragandham Venkata Subba Rao. Later, she separated from him and started living together with Rama Rao who officially married her in 1993.
